objective: An owner-authored synthetic appointment: two named actors attend the named place in a precommitted window. Certifies simulated rendezvous presence only, never productive work, understanding, money or medical effects.

decision.commitment: The offer and causal features are frozen before either plan is written; accept binds the exact new plan SHAs, actor epochs, source sequence and step2. Decline has known utility0 and produces no ground success claim.
decision.capture: Actual accepted root poses and static A* route estimates at choice; no final pose, final reward or future physical completion enters context.

settlement.positive: Only after the whole step2 window closes: matching presence-completed receipts for both actors and one continuous GND3 LOS/contact pair overlapping the window for>=30000ms; exact offered location, plan/source/epoch bindings.
settlement.travelCost: Sum accepted actor root displacements from decision until window closure, cost=units/1000. No reward for distance, arrival, planned/emitted/heard text or unbound generic presence.
settlement.uniqueness: At most one trained sample per goal ID and physical episode; duplicate/tampered/cross-partition outcomes cannot fit again. Cancel/clock mismatch/unsupported/baseline is no fulfillment.
settlement.interruption: No positive credit before deadline; source cancellation, retirement or goal mismatch invalidates fulfillment. Pause gives no duration.

generator.world: Fresh isolated synthetic GND2/GND3 fixture per physical episode; three core actors+one resident+three animals+12ambient cars. This is not a live actor history or a long-horizon society rollout.
generator.plans: Existing meetingSteps at offered place; unavailable peer gets a different place. No speech is needed for fulfillment.
generator.smokeSeeds: 17900-17999 only; debugging correctness, never selection. H1/H2/H4/H6/H10 cohorts and holdout12000-12019 remain untouched.

learning.algorithm: One-pass ridge6D using existing pure LinUCB algebra; new tagged artifact/reward/features/source namespace, alpha0 at frozen evaluation, attend if predicted mean>0 else decline. Decline utility0 is structural, not an invented observed sample.
learning.trainingData: 32 actual replayed attend outcomes, one per distinct synthetic offer. No reweighting/epochs/relabelled user history. Artifact stores only numeric data/provenance, no raw world, dialogue or memories.
learning.evaluation: Frozen model, no fitting validation/holdout. Always-attend baseline and causal route/value/availability heuristic evaluated on the same independently replayed attend potential outcome; declining utility0. This is paired one-step utility on reset synthetic tasks, not a counterfactual city trajectory.
learning.heuristic: attend iff peer intent available and actorRouteUnitsAtChoice/1000 < offeredValue
learning.selection: No parameter search, no tuning after observing validation/holdout. A failure is recorded and keeps runtime unchanged.

gates.functional: Real GND2 replay, exact delayed evidence and causal features; no positive text/unbound/baseline/cancel credit; cap/exact-once; actor/goal/partition/hash validation; deterministic repeat.
gates.promotion: No runtime installation in this phase, even if offline gates pass.
gates.offlineComparison: Holdout12 seed means, paired Student-t95(df11,t=2.201) delta mean utility lower>0 vs always-attend; failed accepted offers per offered task does not increase; retain>=80% positive-utility opportunities; attend share between0.1 and0.9. Report heuristic comparison, oracle one-step opportunity loss, intervals and all negatives.
gates.existingRegressions: Full unit/type/lint/assets/build, old H1 golden byte identity. No browser rerun needed if UI/runtime/schema remain unchanged.

limits.stdout: Only aggregate metrics and hashes; no private source text.
limits.output: Exclusive local artifact files; reject traversal symlink/hardlink/overwrite and invalid ACK-like or unrelated artifacts; no runtime loader.
